speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that history. To begin our assessment, can you tell me how long you have been experiencing this swelling and pain in your right ring finger?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient reports that the pain and swelling in his right ring finger began 2 days ago while playing football. He recalls his finger got caught in the jersey of another player, who then pulled away forcefully.

speaker: Doctor
text: That sounds like a significant traumatic event. Did you notice any deformity, such as the finger appearing crooked or "knuckle-duster" shaped, or did you hear a snapping sound at the time of injury? Also, have you tried to move your finger since it was injured, and if so, is there any resistance or specific pain when bending it?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Progressive swelling and pain in the right ring finger. I also have Inability to flex the right ring finger at the distal interphalangeal joint when making a fist, Pain at the distal interphalangeal joint, Extended right ring finger in resting position.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Mallet Finger (Avulsion fracture of the extensor tendon insertion at the distal phalanx).

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
